uses.quote: This could include work which is written using Gen AI where that use is not permitted even when subsequently edited by the student.
uses.anchor: Falsification of authorship: Unauthorised use of Generative Artificial Intelligence

uses.quote: It could include the use of paraphrasing software and technology that rewrites text even when subsequently edited by the student
uses.anchor: Falsification of authorship: Unauthorised use of Generative Artificial Intelligence

uses.quote: This might include the use of ‘text in an image’ (that is text that is in an image file which may disguise it from text matching software), paraphrasing software or other means used to disguise part or all the content of assessment in any way which could give an unfair advantage.
uses.anchor: Using means to disguise or alter the content of an assessment

uses.quote: This could involve a range of means that make it appear that information has been collected by scientific investigation, the compilation of questionnaire results, interviews etc. whereas, in reality, it has been made up or altered.
uses.anchor: Falsifying experimental or other investigative results

uses.quote: Plagiarism involves taking the work of another person or source and using it as if it were one’s own.
